title: 第七章 同居吧小兰
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

冷汗从柯南的额头沁出。

“他是江户川柯南，博士的远亲。”毛利兰并没有疑心，直接介绍道：“博士的亲戚拜托博士照顾他几天，可是博士说自己不擅长照顾小孩，又拜托了我。”

“阿笠博士？原来博士还有远亲啊，这么多年从没见过他有亲戚来往啊。”工藤新一吐槽起阿笠博士来也十分自然，就像他真的和阿笠博士认识了十几年一样：“我都当他是孤家寡人了。”

“不要在背后议论博士啦。”

“行。”工藤新一点点头：“下次当面议论。”

“哼……总之昨晚我打不通你的电话，就来你家找你，结果在书房看到了博士和柯南。”

“我家书房？”工藤新一做出了疑惑的神情，看向了柯南：“博士带着这小鬼来我家做什么？”

这个问题毛利兰也不知道，甚至她才意识到这个问题，于是也好奇的看向柯南。

柯南的心跳开始加速了：“这是因为……博士、博士爷爷想要带我来找新一哥哥玩，可是新一哥哥不在家，于是带我到书房看书了。”

深吸口气，柯南又想起要补充一点细节，举起双手兴奋地道：“哥哥你家的书房好大哦！”

“带小鬼看书啊……博士确实不会带孩子啊。”工藤新一摇了摇头：“老爸的藏书一半都是推理小说，另一半是他写作需要的自然科学百科。”

言下之意那书房里可没有适合小孩子看的童话书，阿笠博士的这个主意并不高明。

柯南一边心惊这个黑衣人的同伙已经对自己的家了如指掌，一边庆幸起码把这口锅成功甩给阿笠博士了。

就在柯南内心里松口气的瞬间，工藤新一突然做出了突进动作，与柯南拉近了距离。

“说起小说来，话说这小鬼的名字——江户川柯南？”工藤新一近距离的观察着柯南：“哪个江户川？哪个柯南？”

“呃……江户川是我爸爸的江户川……柯南是柯南道尔的柯南。”柯南刚刚放下的心瞬间提到嗓子眼，支支吾吾的说道：“我爸爸是推理小说爱好者啦，我也很喜欢推理小说！”

万幸，虽然江户川乱步这个笔名是根据埃德加的日语谐音设计的，但江户川却是个真实存在的稀有姓氏。

当然了，就日本这个国情，啥千奇百怪的姓氏都有。

“哦……难怪博士带你到书房去。”工藤新一点了点头，但并没有后退，依然极近距离的打量着柯南：“Emm……”

“呃……”柯南的心脏都快从嗓子眼里跳出来了。

“小鬼……你最喜欢的推理小说是哪一部？”打量了半天，工藤新一却只是问道。

柯南一愣，然后立刻说道：“《暗夜男爵》系列！”

事关隐瞒身份，柯南也不至于头铁的坚决拥护福尔摩斯，而是报上了工藤优作的成名作。

“真的假的，居然是老爸的书迷啊。”工藤新一很意外的样子，又好像很欣赏柯南：“看在你是老爸的书迷的份上，以后老爸的书房就对你永久开放吧。”

“太好了！谢谢新一哥哥！”柯南这次反应极快，高举双手欢呼道。

但是柯南心里却在狠狠抱怨：这里明明是我家啊！你把我家的书房向我开放了，我还得谢谢你？太欺负人了！

而一旁毛利兰看着柯南兴奋的样子，忽然灵光一闪：“说起来，干脆让柯南住在新一你这里好了。不但离博士家很近，而且你家这么大，还只有你一个人住。”

毛利家虽然是三层小楼，但一层租给咖啡厅，二楼是事务所，居住区只有三楼的两室一厅，柯南住在毛利家还要在毛利小五郎的床上打地铺。

“你们两个推理迷，可以天天待在一起交流推理小说不是很好吗？”毛利兰又补充了一个理由。

“和这种小鬼交流？”工藤新一故意轻视柯南道：“这种小鬼喜欢推理小说只是觉得侦探很酷吧？”

Cold sweat broke out from Conan's forehead.

"He is Conan Edogawa, a distant relative of the doctor." Mao Lilan introduced directly without any suspicion: "The doctor's relatives asked the doctor to take care of him for a few days, but the doctor said that he was not good at taking care of children, so he asked me to take care of him."

"Dr. Agasa? It turns out that the doctor has distant relatives. I have never seen him have any relatives in all these years." Kudo Shinichi complained about Dr. Agasa very naturally, as if he had really known Dr. Agasa for more than ten years: "I thought he was a loner."

"Don't talk about Doctor behind his back."

"Okay." Kudo Shin nodded: "Let's discuss it in person next time."

"Hmph...Anyway, I couldn't get through your phone last night, so I came to your house to look for you, and I saw the doctor and Conan in the study."

"My study?" Kudo Shinichi looked puzzled and looked at Conan: "Why did the doctor bring this kid to my house?"

Mao Lilan didn't know this question, and she even realized it, so she looked at Conan curiously.

Conan's heart started to beat faster: "This is because... Doctor and Grandpa Doctor wanted to take me to play with Brother Shinichi, but Brother Shinichi was not at home, so he took me to the study to read."

Taking a deep breath, Conan thought of adding some details, raised his hands and said excitedly: "Brother, your study room is so big!"

"Take a kid to read a book... Doctors really don't know how to take care of children." Kudo Shinichi shook his head: "Half of my dad's collection of books are mystery novels, and the other half are natural science encyclopedias that he needs for writing."

The implication is that there are no fairy tale books suitable for children in the study. Dr. A Li's idea is not a bright one.

Conan was horrified that the accomplice of the man in black knew everything about his home, but at the same time he was glad that at least he had successfully passed the blame on Dr. A Li.

At the moment when Conan was relieved, Kudo Shinichi suddenly made a sudden move, closing the distance with Conan.

"Speaking of novels, what is this kid's name - Edogawa Conan?" Kudo Shinichi observed Conan closely: "Which Edogawa? Which Conan?"

"Uh... Edogawa is my father's Edogawa... Conan is Conan Doyle's Conan." Conan's heart suddenly rose to his throat as he said hesitantly: "My father is a fan of mystery novels, and I also like mystery novels!"

Fortunately, although the pen name Edogawa Ranpo was designed based on the Japanese homophony of Edgar, Edogawa is a real and rare surname.

Of course, given Japan’s national conditions, there are all kinds of strange surnames.

"Oh... no wonder the doctor took you to the study." Kudo Shin nodded, but did not retreat. He still looked at Conan very closely: "Emm..."

"Uh..." Conan's heart almost jumped out of his throat.

"Kid...which is your favorite mystery novel?" After looking at it for a long time, Kudo Shinichi just asked.

Conan was stunned for a moment, and then immediately said: "The "Night Baron" series!"

When it comes to concealing his identity, Conan will not firmly support Sherlock Holmes, but instead reports on Kudo Yusaku's famous work.

"Really or not, you are actually a fan of my dad's books." Kudo Shinichi looked very surprised, and seemed to admire Conan very much: "For the sake of you being a fan of my dad's books, my dad's study will be open to you forever from now on."

"Great! Thank you, Brother Shinichi!" Conan reacted very quickly this time, raising his hands in the air and cheering.

But Conan was complaining fiercely in his heart: This is obviously my home!You opened my study room to me, and I have to thank you?What a bully!

Looking at Conan's excitement, Mao Lilan suddenly had an idea: "Speaking of which, let's just let Conan live with you, Shinichi. Not only is it very close to the doctor's house, but your house is so big, and you are the only one living there."

Although Mouri's house is a three-story building, the first floor is rented to a coffee shop and the second floor is an office. The living area only has two bedrooms and one living room on the third floor. When Conan lived in Moori's house, he had to make the floor on Kogoro Mouri's bed.

"Wouldn't it be great for you two mystery fans to stay together every day and exchange mystery novels?" Mao Lilan added another reason.

"Communicate with this kid?" Kudo Shinichi deliberately looked down on Conan and said, "This kid likes mystery novels and just thinks detectives are cool, right?"
